body:
S540, founder real-time: 'finish shipping the new WOTAN stuff / wotan.okemily.com should be the front door to the online social tournament site.' Rebuilt+restarted iduna.service to carry the S536/S537 friends/profiles/duels routes for the first time (running binary predated those commits). Redeployed friends.html/profile.html (committed but never rsynced). Live-verified end to end against real production: two throwaway DEADWEIGHT accounts registered/upgraded/logged in through wotan.okemily.com's own /api/ proxy, real friend request sent+accepted, real duel challenged+accepted, real match_token minted, public profile reflected the new friend count. index.html rewritten to drop 'under construction' framing and lead with the live social features; OKEMILY/tournaments.html got a matching banner pointing to the new front door instead of the old reverse direction. Commits: IDUNA b5ac93a, WOTAN fc2c7b1, OKEMILY 0f89682.

⚓ ☃
title: wotan.okemily.com is now the front door
